FN-NR3FZ8T-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 474
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Craig Lipscomb
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/07/2025
House Bill 474 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama State
Law Enforcement Agency to develop a procedure for processing an affidavit for local law
enforcement agencies pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
In addition, this bill provides that fees collected by local law enforcement for processing
affidavits for removal of individuals from certain places may be deposited into the sheriff's
discretionary account or the general fund of the municipality, as applicable, to be used for law
enforcement purposes.
